error[ZBX-E1201]: lazy start is not possible on this host
  while  checking that this user can open /dev/fuse for the lazy run
  cause  opening /dev/fuse read-write failed: permission denied (EACCES)
  cause  /dev/fuse is not openable: this user may not open it
  device /dev/fuse
  fix    give users read and write on /dev/fuse (the fuse udev rule, mode 0666)
         or run it without --lazy, which reads the whole image first
  more   zbx explain E1201
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1201.html
